test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The consultant suggested that the firm (1)/ discontinues the outdated product line (2)/ so as to focus more resources (3)/ on innovation. (4)/
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is located in **part (2)** of the sentence.
 
• The verb "**suggested**" is a verb of recommendation and is followed by a "that" clause, which dictates the use of the **subjunctive mood**.
 
• In the subjunctive mood, the verb inside the "that" clause must take its base form (bare infinitive), regardless of whether the subject is singular or plural.
 
• Therefore, the singular present tense verb "**discontinues**" must be changed to the base form "**discontinue**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The consultant suggested that the firm **discontinue the outdated** product line so as to focus more resources on innovation."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: (1) **– This part is grammatically correct. "The consultant suggested that the firm" correctly sets up the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: (3)** – This part is grammatically correct. "so as to focus more resources" is a valid infinitive phrase indicating purpose.
 
• **Option 4: (4)** – This part is grammatically correct and correctly attaches to the preceding phrase.
